94024.company: Mission Trail Waste Systems (served under the City of Los Altos / Zero Waste Los Altos program)
94024.bottle: Recycle in the blue cart: empty plastic bottles and glass bottles/jars (no liquids; caps generally OK if left on plastic bottles; remove non-bottle attachments like pumps).
94024.cup: Do NOT recycle most disposable cups: paper coffee cups and plastic/compostable-lined cups go in the trash unless they are certified-compostable and you have a compost/organics cart (then compost only if accepted by the local organics program). Clean rigid plastic cups may be recyclable only if accepted as rigid plastic containers; when in doubt, trash.
94024.wine glass: Do not put in recycling (different glass composition). Wrap to protect workers and place in trash.
94024.vase: Do not put in curbside recycling. Put in trash (wrap broken glass), or donate/reuse if in good condition.
94024.default: Los Altos curbside recycling (blue cart) is for clean mixed paper/cardboard and accepted containers (metal cans, plastic bottles/containers, and glass bottles/jars). Keep items empty and reasonably clean; bagged recyclables, food-soiled paper, ceramics/crystal/pyrex, and non-container glass (drinkware, vases) belong in the trash (or reuse/donate when possible).
